svg.title: AREA 11
svg.desc: Open the cage; its player holds the piston pad. Release only after the others are clear underneath. Use only middle-right and bottom-left as drawn; the other four trigger explosions. After clearing, the collector takes the left passage switch to open the party’s gate. Four targets: underwater right of entry, ceiling above it, rocks above-left of the exit, and grass by the exit. Use a gun or Foie/Zonde. Two take the warp branch: one holds green to reveal the light path. After the other crosses, the holder warps back. Follow the white lights exactly; stepping off triggers explosions. Wait for the light-path player, then hold both exit pads together. Ignore enemies here; regroup through 3.
